fact: On 16 February 2025 the Interior Ministry's Civil Status Sector reported it was itself issuing national ID cards and computerised documents day to day, 6,320 cards and 28,521 documents in one round of its convoys across ten governorates.
title: قطاع الأحوال المدنية يواصل إيفاد القوافل المجهزة فنياً ولوجيستياً بالعديد من المحافظات
